create_wav2vec2_asr_recipe: create a Wav2Vec2AsrRecipe to train an ASR model with CTC loss and pretrained encoder initialization
prepare_ctc_training_from_encoder: prepare CTC training by sharing encoder parameters from a pretrained wav2vec2 SSL model

build_wav2vec2_asr_train_unit: build a Wav2Vec2AsrTrainUnit that processes batches and manages encoder freezing during training
